pages.text: $(l)Carbon Fiber$() is the tier 2 material. The Advanced and Elite Drone Frames are made of it, as real racing drones are: light and stiff.

Carbon Fiber is drawn out of $(l)Methane$(), a gas, onto plain $(l)String$():$(br)$(li)A $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l) makes Methane.$(br)$(li)A $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l) carries it to a $(l:materials/pyrolysis_oven)Pyrolysis Oven$(/l).
pages.title: Making it

pages.text: $(li)The oven turns $(l)250 mB of Methane + 1 String$() into $(l)1 Carbon Fiber$(), in 4 seconds at 120 FE/t.$(br)So the gas tier is more than power: its methane is the raw material of every advanced frame.
